elements.name: Prepare relay sortie
elements.description: Review request, choose configuration, check declared gates. Reject dispatch if a gate or required operational evidence is missing.

elements.name: Establish service
elements.description: Climb, transit, and establish. Unsuccessful establishment ends service attempt and prompts intended recovery.
elements.postcondition: Station reached and both hops established

elements.name: Sustain relay service
elements.description: Relay A-to-B traffic while monitoring resources. Physical service delivery is not simulated.

elements.name: End service and recover
elements.description: Return horizontally and descend at base. Off-nominal recovery is a described responsibility.

elements.name: Restore readiness
elements.description: Inspect and replace/recharge pack as appropriate. No turnaround-time model.

elements.name: Clear and adequate service hops
elements.description: For each declared service hop, the analysis shall require clearance margin at least 0 m relative to the wall top plus 5 m and link margin at least 10 dB above the -90 dBm assumed receiver threshold.
elements.requirement_text: For each declared service hop, the analysis shall require clearance margin at least 0 m relative to the wall top plus 5 m and link margin at least 10 dB above the -90 dBm assumed receiver threshold.

elements.name: Requested service duration
elements.description: Under the declared continuous-service assumptions, the analysis shall require energy-supported relay dwell of at least mission.dwell_s (baseline 900 s).
elements.requirement_text: Under the declared continuous-service assumptions, the analysis shall require energy-supported relay dwell of at least mission.dwell_s (baseline 900 s).

elements.name: Mission energy and reserve
elements.description: For each option, planned mission energy plus reserve shall not exceed nominal_energy_wh times usable_fraction. Reserve is reserve_fraction of usable energy.
elements.requirement_text: For each option, planned mission energy plus reserve shall not exceed nominal_energy_wh times usable_fraction. Reserve is reserve_fraction of usable energy.

elements.name: Gross mass ceiling
elements.description: For each option, installed gross mass shall not exceed vehicle.max_gross_mass_kg (baseline 5.5 kg).
elements.requirement_text: For each option, installed gross mass shall not exceed vehicle.max_gross_mass_kg (baseline 5.5 kg).

elements.name: Continuous bus power
elements.description: For each option, the highest modeled segment bus demand shall not exceed vehicle.continuous_bus_limit_w (baseline 1400 W). Transients remain unassessed.
elements.requirement_text: For each option, the highest modeled segment bus demand shall not exceed vehicle.continuous_bus_limit_w (baseline 1400 W). Transients remain unassessed.

diagrams.name: Mission context
diagrams.purpose: A-to-B service crosses the relay aircraft. Carrier command/status is a separate path; terrain constrains the service geometry.

diagrams.name: Service requirements
diagrams.purpose: Engineering requirements derive from the service need. Dashed verify links identify check responsibilities; they do not claim demonstrated communications performance.

diagrams.name: Recovery requirements
diagrams.purpose: Energy, installed mass and continuous demand constrain the planned sortie. Thresholds remain illustrative and actual recovery has not been demonstrated.

diagrams.name: Interface and evidence requirements
diagrams.purpose: Installation evidence, comparison records and reproducibility have different checks. The interface review remains open even when the numerical tests pass.

diagrams.name: Operational use cases
diagrams.purpose: Rounded nodes represent use cases. Actor associations express participation, not execution order. Restore readiness is described but not simulated.

diagrams.name: Mission functions
diagrams.purpose: Solid arrows indicate the nominal function sequence. Dashed arrows indicate supporting responsibilities, avoiding the suggestion that monitoring and power are extra timed flight segments.

diagrams.name: Logical blocks
diagrams.purpose: Composition groups responsibilities independently of hardware. Class compartments list responsibilities, not implemented software methods.

diagrams.name: Physical composition
diagrams.purpose: Composition shows owned physical groups. Each box is a reusable block type; the labeled relationship is the part role. Both battery choices use this same structure.

diagrams.name: Airborne interfaces
diagrams.purpose: Solid edges carry electrical supply; the dashed edge carries flight commands. Interface types and conjugated port directions remain explicit in the model tables.

diagrams.name: Service and carrier interfaces
diagrams.purpose: The served endpoints are external. Mission traffic and carrier control enter different aircraft responsibilities; no throughput or command-link reliability is demonstrated here.

diagrams.name: Mission lifecycle
diagrams.purpose: The diagram specifies intended operational decisions. The evaluator checks a planned sortie and does not implement live flight control or off-nominal recovery.

diagrams.name: Installed mass constraint
diagrams.purpose: Undirected lines mean equality bindings between named values and constraint parameters. The mount increment is separate from pack mass. Python evaluates the relation.

diagrams.name: Energy and reserve constraint
diagrams.purpose: One reserve deduction is applied to usable energy. Binding lines state equality, not calculation order; the constraint expression is listed below the figure in the book.

diagrams.name: Supported dwell constraint
diagrams.purpose: The maximum energy-supported dwell retains its sign. A negative value means the nonservice sortie already exceeds the allowance. Radio, mass and power checks still apply.

diagrams.name: Configuration decision
diagrams.purpose: Six options share one mission and requirement basis. The selection is provisional and never converts missing hardware or physical evidence into a pass.

diagrams.name: Propulsion power constraint
diagrams.purpose: Fixed rotor geometry and a propulsion-only reference operating point define the provisional hover electrical law. The shared multiplier is a sensitivity input, not a wind model.

diagrams.name: Segment energy constraint
diagrams.purpose: Propulsion and auxiliary loads are accounted at the main bus. The payload regulator loss enters once. Duration times power is converted from joules to Wh by dividing by 3600.
